synonyms: Somehow, The Villainess Who Regressed in Time Lost Her Magic Power, so She Turned into a Secluded Maiden
The Villainess Who Traveled Back in Time Inexplicably Lost Her Magic, So She Went into Seclusion
synopsis: Rachel only became the fiancée of the Prince due to her high magic power. That’s why when the Saint appeared, she feared that her position would be taken away from her. As a punishment for her vile deed against the Saint, her engagement was annulled and she was banished to the monastery. But on the way to the monastery, she was attacked by bandits. Just as Rachel thought she was about to die, she suddenly woke up and found out that she had returned to three years ago. However, she no longer had her high magic power and became so sickly that she could hardly even sit up in her bed. Rachel was just happy that she was alive and decided to cancel the engagement; yet for some reason, the Prince refused!?

titleNative: LOST MAN
synopsis: There lives a man who has lost his memory and can’t remember where he’s from, and who he is, including his name. He just goes by the name Matsumoto and the one and only thing he remembers is how to play soccer. However, the one thing he does remember, he does exceptionally well, even better than the professionals. He sells his ridiculous soccer skills to teams and guarantees them goals and, even more important, wins. As he travels from city to city, country to country playing for money, he hopes that he regains his memory.

She patiently waits for her lover Eloi, but all that returns is the news that the Emperor has beheaded him. Hopeless in her own imprisonment, Niobe ends her life only to be returned to the past–exactly two years before her marriage with Valon. With the second chance at life, Niobe is determined to conceal and protect her true love. (Source: POCKET COMICS) Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.

titleNative: 死に戻り公女は繰り返す世界を終わらせたい
synonyms: She Who Returned from Death Wishing to End the Repeating World
synopsis: I can't die yet...! A loop mystery in which you fight against your impending fate. Princess Liliana is betrothed to the kingdom's crown prince as a hostage in order to secure peace between the kingdom and the principality. One day, at a ball, the prince, having found a new lover, unilaterally breaks off the engagement and falsely accuses her of operating a gambling den for profit and embezzlement. Exiled and sent to the frontier, Liliana is attacked and killed along the way... only to find herself transported back to the day before the ball! Liliana works hard to gather evidence to avoid being falsely accused, and with the help of a mysterious man named Zeke, she successfully infiltrates the gambling den. However, her life is targeted there as well, and both of them lose their lives. Who is the culprit relentlessly pursuing Liliana's life...? To put an end to the cycle of death, Liliana and Zeke's battle begins now! (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

He always comes out on top no matter what he does, and Hikari is determined to do whatever it takes to beat this guy...somehow! At age 6 Hikari lost to Kei in an impromptu wrestling match.
